title: michelia tsiampacca var. champaca
intro: Michelia tsiampacca var. champaca, commonly known as the yellow champak or Philippine golden rain tree, is a flowering plant species in the magnolia family (Magnoliaceae). This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties that can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Michelia tsiampacca var. champaca include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help protect against oxidative stress and regulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
